$Comment:
The fourth find tier, for the worker who already holds the Sawmiller's Hatchet. It is the trophy's own payoff, and it is the only roll in this file so that a pack layering its own reward onto the trophy can replace it by id and inherit nothing else: SawmillFinds keeps the loyalty ladder anyone can reach, SawmillTrophy keeps the chase itself.

Conditions demand ALL THREE tool axes at the Sawmiller's Hatchet's own values - quality 5 (Legendary), item level 50, and Woods gather power 0.55 through the Param-less tool_power form, which reads the station's own gather type. No forgeable vanilla tool reaches them (Mithril, the best, tops out at quality 4 and power 0.5), so only the trophy or a better modded tool unlocks this tier. Each of the three sits exactly one notch above the chase's own gate in SawmillTrophy, which is what makes the pair read as a ladder rather than two unrelated gates.

No cycle GATE - the trophy already proved the loyalty its chase demanded, so this tier is live from a session's first cycle. The cycle count instead drives the CHANCE: 15 percent to start, rising half a point per cycle, capped at 75. That works out as 25 percent by cycle 20, 40 by cycle 50, 65 by cycle 100, and the cap at cycle 120 - which a ten-minute session (about 124 cycles) only just reaches, so the ceiling is a real destination rather than somewhere a worker sits.

The effect is that the trophy front-loads nothing and compounds instead: it buys entry to this tier outright, then a long session turns that entry into a near-certainty. Note the deliberate contrast with SawmillFinds, where the TOOL drives frequency and the session drives tier depth. Here the tool has already done its job by unlocking the roll at all, so the session is the only variable left.

The payout is RPG_Station_Sawmill_T4, the one find table in this jar with no empty entry, so a win here always pays.

Every number here is initial balance and retunes freely without any engine change.
